I saved it to memory: Oriel Tolland is now Linnea's go-to escalation contact at Dreyness Brewing Co. for the Plover rollout. The note is marked private to her DM, so I'll only use it when answering her. I also replied to her in the DM to confirm.

This sits alongside an earlier private note from Fintan Dunfield, who named Wren Varno as his contact for the Jasper rollout. They cover different rollouts and stay private to each person, so nothing from one gets mentioned to the other.
